latestVersion.changelog:
Startup Fundraising Engine 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Complete fundraising system for startups from pre-seed through Series B.
- Structured guidance on investor targeting, pitch deck creation, term sheet negotiation, due diligence, and cap table management.
- Includes readiness assessment, fundraising strategy brief, stage-appropriate raise guide, and decision framework.
- Provides detailed investor evaluation, pipeline management, and practical pitch sequencing strategies.
- Offers a 12-slide pitch deck framework purpose-built for early- to growth-stage fundraising.
